title: Retire unused legacy chattic resources after an observation period
description:
Checklist, only after an observation period with no traffic and with the owner's approval:

- [ ] legacy ChatticusMarketing stack (drifted)
- [ ] Python Function URL and its WAITLIST and CONTACT items (confirm the 2 items were migrated)

Feature: Legacy retirement

comments.text: Final inventory facts 2026-10-19 (nothing deleted yet): the legacy marketing distribution E2KIMGDJ4DW3XZ has no aliases; the Python intake Function URL and its two data items remain; the old stacks remain. Development now runs in the production AWS account, and the old chatticus-development account has been wiped of Chatticus resources (only CDK bootstrap remains).

right_now_summary: Legacy Chattic resources await a no-traffic observation period and owner approval before removal.
